description: Source file for a custom enhanced regular expression compilation function 'git_regcomp' that wraps the standard 'regcomp' with added functionality to handle REG_EXTENDED flag by substituting it with REG_ENHANCED before calling the standard 'regcomp'.

methods.name: int git_regcomp(regex_t * preg,const char * pattern,int cflags)
methods.description: Enhances standard regcomp by substituting REG_EXTENDED with REG_ENHANCED if necessary.
